title: The UK's Failed Experiment in Rail Privatization
summary: Wendover Productions explains how UK rail privatization worked and why it failed. It covers the fragmented operator and infrastructure structure and why market forces apply poorly to rail.
why: Recommended in privatization and rail threads as a clear, well-sourced explanation of the UK rail mess.

quote.text: the people on the Wendover YouTube channel did a video on this back in March which explained the issue really well.
